title: Terminal — shell emulator with live passthrough + PTY seam
description: A React-DOM terminal: monospace glass aesthetic, colored prompt, arrow-key history, red stderr, mode banner. A built-in command set (ls·cd·pwd·cat·mkdir·touch·rm·mv·cp·echo·whoami·date·uname·df·ps·neofetch·help·clear) runs against an in-memory FsModel, so it works with ZERO backend. Wire configureTerminal({ mode:"live", fs, exec, sys }) and ls/cat read through your real filesystem, file mutations mirror to it, host-truth commands (df/ps/whoami/uname/date) and any unknown command pass through exec.run as a one-shot shell call (stdout/stderr/exit rendered), and neofetch shows real sys.stats. For a REAL interactive shell (vim/top/tab-completion) wire configurePty({ transport, screen }) — transport streams PTY bytes (createSsePtyTransport ships the os-vps SSE wire shape) and screen injects your VT renderer (e.g. xterm.js); a touch key bar (Esc/Tab/sticky Ctrl·Alt/arrows/chords/paste) covers soft keyboards. Self-contained: shell inspector hooks are inert seams and the default OsApi is a mock adapter in lib/host-mock.ts.
